# isee

> Python continuous integration (CI) support tools.


## Pages in this subsection

- [isee](isee.html.md): Tools for CI
- [isee.common](isee.common.html.md): This module contains common functions that are used in multiple modules.
- [isee.file_modification_utils](isee.file_modification_utils.html.md): This module provides utilities for updating files.
- [isee.generation_utils](isee.generation_utils.html.md): Generation utils for the isee package.
- [isee.git_utils](isee.git_utils.html.md): Utilities for working with git repositories.
- [isee.local_cli](isee.local_cli.html.md): Run GitHub Actions workflows locally using act.
- [isee.pip_utils](isee.pip_utils.html.md): Utilities for reading a project’s declared dependencies and installing them.
- [isee.pylint_log_synopsis](isee.pylint_log_synopsis.html.md): This module provides utilities for working with pylint logs.
